statement.zh: 希拉孔波利斯（Kom el-Ahmar）神庙区工作与主窖藏——关联纳尔迈调色板及相关早期王室器物（组合级）——见 Quibell 1900 与 Quibell & Green 1902。一战统一解读留假说栏；不托管伪造调色板图。
statement.en: At Hierakonpolis (Kom el-Ahmar), temple-area work and the Main Deposit—linked to the Narmer Palette and related early royal objects at assemblage level—are documented in Quibell 1900 and Quibell & Green 1902. Single-battle unification readings stay in the hypothesis column; no forged palette imagery is hosted.
